# Barr Estate Winery (concept by Kerblabs)

> Estate winery and olive oil on Union Road in the Geneseo District of Paso Robles, California. Facts from barrestatewines.com. This is a free concept, not their official site.

- Address: 6950 Union Road, east side of Paso Robles, Geneseo District, CA
- Website: https://www.barrestatewines.com
- Hours: Fri to Sun, 11 to 4; last tasting 3:15 pm
- Tasting fee listed: $20 (confirm with winery)

## Wines
- Aglianico, Albarino, Cabernet Sauvignon, Malbec, Mourvedre, Petit Verdot, Petite Sirah, Primitivo, Tannat
- 100% extra virgin olive oil

## FAQ
- Where? 6950 Union Road, Paso Robles.
- When? Friday to Sunday, 11 to 4.
- Prices? Only the $20 tasting fee was seen; bottle prices not captured.
